name: Bird Alliance of Central Indiana Birdathon Grants
summary: Small grants for bird-focused projects in Central Indiana, including research, education and stewardship, and preservation or restoration of natural habitat.

amount.note: Most are $1,000 to $2,000; larger amounts may be considered for major projects

reporting: A project progress report with details on the use of funds and measured results is due by January 31 of the following year.

status.quote: The deadline for submissions is February 25 at 5:00 pm EST.

recurring.quote: The deadline for submissions is February 25 at 5:00 pm EST.

geography.quote: Preservation or restoration of natural habitats in Central Indiana or habitat that is important to the birds of Central Indiana

access.quote: Your proposal should be submitted (electronically and hard copy) on your organization's letterhead

window.quote: The deadline for submissions is February 25 at 5:00 pm EST.

amount.quote: Birdathon grants are typically in the range of $500 to $5,000 with most in the $1,000 to $2,000 range. However, for major projects, larger amounts may be considered.

reporting.quote: If you receive funding from BACI, you will be required to submit a project progress report by January 31 of the following year including details on the use of funds and measured results.
